archetype: CLASSIC FMCG & ORGANIC TRUST (Catch Masala Inspired)
design_philosophy: White base background everywhere, solid corporate trust, clean FMCG aesthetic with crisp grid lines, warm spice accent highlights, legible typography, and structured B2B & retail product storytelling. Motion is restrained, purpose-driven, and subtle.

brand_identity.name: Savrel Natural Spices
brand_identity.description: Manufacturer of premium Indian spices, including whole spices, powders, and masala blends. Hygienically processed and packed for bulk, wholesale, and private-label supply. Quality ingredients, consistent taste, and timely delivery across India. Contact us for samples and bulk orders.

contact.address: G-418,419, UPSIDC, M.G. Road, Uttar Pradesh 201015

brand_identity.logo_spec: Red and deep orange oval emblem with white bold serif typography 'Savrel Natural' and subtle yellow curve underline with tagline 'Masale Jo Swaad Banaye'. Located prominently in top-left header.

typography.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-gray-900 leading-tight
typography.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold text-gray-900 leading-snug
typography.caption: text-sm text-gray-500

layout_and_spacing.header_style: Sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 shadow-sm
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all p-6
layout_and_spacing.b2b_banner: bg-gradient-to-r from-red-700 via-red-600 to-amber-700 text-white rounded-2xl p-8 sm:p-12 shadow-lg

motion.rule: Subtle reveals and smooth tabs. NO floaty parallax or distracting animations.

key_features: 11 full pages with top navbar navigation and breadcrumbs
B2B Bulk Sample Request Modal / Sticky Enquiry Form
Product Catalog filtering by category (Whole Spices, Powders, Masala Blends)
Packaging & Specifications table per spice product
Interactive Private Labeling process flow diagram
Quality certificates (FSSAI, ISO 9001:2015, Organic) showcase with downloadable spec sheets simulator
Founder profile section highlighting Rohit Jha's vision and manufacturing standard
Address block with map-style visualization and direct contact details
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure background is clean WHITE across all pages and sections as requested.
Place the red/orange oval brand logo at top left with tagline 'Masale Jo Swaad Banaye'.
Use exact customer product images for Black Pepper, Cloves, Turmeric, Red Chilli, and Hero banner.
Implement clear navigation bar containing all 11 page links (or grouped dropdown for Products).
